name: Indicator groups
description: Every indicator group and its sub-groups

name: Indicator series
description: The values over time for one field

name: Companies in a market
description: Every company listed on a market (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU)

name: Analyst estimates
description: Analyst estimates for one company, yearly or quarterly

name: Fund managers
description: Every fund-management firm Argaam tracks, with how many funds each has

name: Funds of a manager
description: The funds run by one fund manager

name: Fund details
description: One fund in full: objective, strategy, eligibility, fees, minimums, size, start date

name: Fund price history
description: Every end-of-day unit price and net asset value of one fund between two dates (yyyy-MM-dd)

name: Fund latest value
description: One fund's latest unit price, net asset value and return this year, with the date of that price

name: Top-moving funds
description: The 10 funds that gained most and the 10 that lost most this year

name: M&A deals in a market
description: Every merger, acquisition and stake deal in one market (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU), newest first: date, value, type, status, acquirers, targets

name: M&A deal details
description: One deal's full record: everything in the market list plus how it was financed (financialWaysList)

name: Projects in a market
description: Every capital project in one market (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU), newest first: name, country, cost, status, start and expected completion. Fetched as one big page (page=1, pageSize=5000); some projects repeat in identical rows

name: Project details
description: One project's full record: description, category, city, cost and its unit, dates, owner and related companies, comments, production capacity

name: Company key developments
description: A company's dated key developments (stock symbol, e.g. 2222), each with links to the Argaam article
